mutants.name: held-never-set
mutants.old: heldConfirmKey = event.keyCode   // confirmKey answers only 36, 76 and 53

mutants.name: repeat-not-swallowed
mutants.old: if event.type == .keyDown, event.isARepeat, event.keyCode == heldConfirmKey { return true }
mutants.new: if event.type == .keyDown, event.isARepeat, event.keyCode == heldConfirmKey { return false }

mutants.name: keyup-never-releases
mutants.old: if event.type == .keyUp { if event.keyCode == heldConfirmKey { heldConfirmKey = nil }; return false }

mutants.name: resign-keeps-hold
mutants.old: heldConfirmKey = nil   // #1937: its keyUp goes to whoever is key then

mutants.name: ime-not-checked
mutants.old: if (responder as? NSTextInputClient)?.hasMarkedText() == true { return false }
